statement: Fix a coefficient prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, schemes X,Y, a morphism f:X→Y and a compactification c=(j,p). Use the actual completed coefficient sheaf and its finite quotient projections [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], derived scalar extension and restriction [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction], and the fixed finite compact-support candidate [def-weil-compact-support-candidate]. For an arbitrary completed-coefficient complex K define the nth term to be Res_n Rp_{*,n} j_{!,n}(K tensor^L A_{n+1}). Its adjacent transition is Res_{n+1} applied to compact support of the scalar-extension adjunct of the lower reduction unit, followed by the specified compact-support scalar comparison [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars] and the canonical restriction associator. The latter uses equality of successive completed quotient projections. This extracts the existing definitions, with names, signatures, bodies and all transitions unchanged, from lem-sf-integral-compact-support-constructible.
